roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Provider and RWD Health Systems Applications

bullets: Collaborate with clinical product management, EMR, user experience product management, marketing, medical and a broad cross functional team to drive product strategy and roadmap,
Drive integration of genomic tests into the platform (Signatera/ctDNA, hereditary risk, tumor/normal and NGS profiling, liquid CGP, etc.) as part of a unified oncology digitized…
Work closely with AI/ML teams to build applications for patient-level insights and clinic-level insights, including cohort comparison, clinical trial matching, and cohort…
Partner with legal, privacy, and security so HIPAA obligations, PHI handling, and data-governance requirements are designed into the product.

roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Lab Execution CGP (Oncology)

bullets: Own the product strategy and roadmap for Lab Execution software in our CGP labs spanning across extraction, library prep, sequencing, and assay QC.
Translate Oncology business goals (launch timelines, volume growth, turnaround time, and COGS) into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap.
Drive a platform mindset: reusable, configurable capabilities that serve multiple assays and labs instead of one-off builds.
Champion AI-forward products that reduce manual touchpoints, surface exceptions early, and make lab operators more effective.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, ClinicalAI Real-World Data (RWD)

bullets: Own the user-experience backlog and priorities for the user-facing application, including case review and editing, document navigation and evidence, work queues, and…
Increase efficiencies without tradeoffs to accuracy: shadow end users, measure where the time goes, and validate problems before they become backlog commitments.
Turn intricate, multi-step review workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces.
Own how new AI capabilities appear to end users; define the experience, pilot with leads, and roll out without disrupting live production work.
Own agentic workflows end to end, from discovery through launch, validation, and iteration: translate a stakeholder team’s needs into a phased workflow, decide where AI agents act…

roles.title: Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera Hematologic Oncology (Heme)

bullets: Develop and execute the Signatera product roadmap for hematologic malignancies, beginning with multiple myeloma and lymphomas (for example, DLBCL, follicular, mantle cell, and…
Lead market entry planning for Signatera in heme as a laboratory developed test (LDT), including clinical validation requirements, CLIA and state requirements, market…
Define product requirements for blood-based malignancies with R&D, Lab Operations, and Software Engineering, including assay, sample type, workflow, and reporting needs.
Lead product support for clinical trials using Signatera in heme, including IUO use in studies with pharma and academic partners, and the path toward IVD and regulated use.
Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, and Business Development on trial start-up, study requirements, and pharma and companion diagnostic opportunities.
